description: Land Acquisition - Amendment Act No. 28 of 1964, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition and divestment matters. It specifically deals with the divestment of certain allotments of land under the Land Acquisition Act, including detailed descriptions of land parcels, their boundaries, and extents. The content focuses on land-related administrative actions (vesting and divesting land to/from the State) and contains no government personnel changes or structural modifications beyond the ministerial authorization required for land transactions.
